kpis.description_fr: Revenu total JD Sports. Croissance tirée par expansion internationale Hibbett (US) et progression Europe, malgré environnement consommation difficile.
kpis.description_en: JD Sports total revenue. Growth driven by Hibbett (US) expansion and Europe progression, despite challenging consumer environment.
kpis._specific_to: JD Sports / acquisition Hibbett Sports US

kpis._specific_to: JD Sports / KPI retail LFL spécifique

kpis.description_fr: Nombre total de magasins JD Sports (toutes enseignes). Saut FY25 lié à l'intégration de Hibbett (~1170 magasins US).
kpis.description_en: Total JD Sports store count (all banners). FY25 jump from Hibbett integration (~1170 US stores).

kpis.description_en: EMEA region revenue (UK and continental Europe). Historical market, JD lifestyle UK leader, controlled expansion in France and Germany.
kpis._specific_to: JD Sports / leader UK sneaker lifestyle
